answer: At the dawn of each epoch the network anchor each new AI agent to a cryptographic stake that can only be unlocked by proof of work performed on a unique hardware fingerprint. Recruiters earn referral rewards only when downstream agents later contribute verified compute toward a consensus summit, otherwise the reward is zeroed out. An attacker must therefore provision distinct hardware and sustain full‑node operation for every fake identity, raising the cost linearly with the number of Sybils.
